description: Returns the full text of one jwatte.com item by its id (article:<slug>, download:<file name> or tool:<slug>): an article's published Markdown (the same text as its .md page), the text of a downloadable kit when it is a text file, or a website tool's catalog entry. Metadata gives dates, links, sizes and related downloads. A text longer than 100,000 characters is cut at a paragraph break and ends with a line giving the address of the full text. Answers come from the copy bundled with this server; nothing is fetched from the web.

id.description: An id such as article:<slug>, download:<file name> or tool:<slug>.

name: fetch
